points.K7: 资源二：管理制度和操作规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，门旁有安全出口标志和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway next to an emergency exit sign and a wall-mounted fire extinguisher, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室的应急准备。
overlay: 应急准备：有备才能无患

shots.scene: 报警器、文件夹、洗眼器、电话四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a ceiling alarm detector, a blank binder, an eyewash station and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 会预警、有预案、会使用、会报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天到实验室，直接走向实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student arrives at a lab on his first day and heads straight for a bench, putting on a lab coat.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，就想马上开工。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向墙上的洗眼器和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points at an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研问他：洗眼器、灭火器在哪儿？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a big question mark floating above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰答不上来。真出事，可就来不及了。

shots.section_title: 意外难免，先做最坏准备
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地竖起手指，身后是整洁的实验室
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a serious face in front of a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 再小心，意外也可能发生。
overlay: 意外难免，先做最坏准备

shots.section_title: 意外难免，先做最坏准备
shots.scene: 一面盾牌图标挡在警示三角前
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon standing in front of a yellow warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要先想好最坏的情况，提前准备。

shots.section_title: 自动预警：一氧化碳、烟雾、高温
shots.scene: 天花板上的探测器发出提示光
shots.prompt_en: A white ceiling-mounted detector glows with a small blinking light in a lab ceiling. No people.
shots.narration: 最好有自动预警系统，提前发现险情。
overlay: 自动预警：一氧化碳、烟雾、高温

shots.section_title: 自动预警：一氧化碳、烟雾、高温
shots.scene: 一氧化碳分子、烟雾、温度计三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a gas molecule cloud, a puff of grey smoke and a thermometer with a high reading. No people.
shots.narration: 监测一氧化碳、烟雾和异常高温。

shots.section_title: 盯住有害物的接触限值
shots.scene: 气体探测仪上的指针接近红色区域
shots.prompt_en: A blank gas detector panel with a needle gauge approaching a red zone. No people.
shots.narration: 还要监测所用有害物在空气中的浓度。
overlay: 盯住有害物的接触限值

shots.section_title: 盯住有害物的接触限值
shots.scene: 一条水平红线，浓度曲线始终在线下
shots.prompt_en: A simple chart with a horizontal red limit line and a green curve staying below it. No people.
shots.narration: 确保不超过国家规定的职业接触限值。

shots.section_title: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜
shots.scene: 天花板通风管道，箭头表示空气流动
shots.prompt_en: Lab ceiling ventilation ducts with blue arrows showing air flowing in and out. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室通风要持续运行，不断换气。
overlay: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜

shots.section_title: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜
shots.scene: 房间图标里空气循环箭头转了几圈
shots.prompt_en: A lab room icon with circular arrows looping several times to show repeated air changes. No people.
shots.narration: 每小时多次换气，具体按设计和规定。

shots.section_title: 通风持续运行，不只靠通风柜
shots.scene: 通风柜和整个房间的排风同时工作
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood exhausting air upward while ceiling vents also draw air from the whole room. No people.
shots.narration: 排风不能只靠通风柜一个出口。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出四根手指，身旁浮现四张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up four fingers beside four floating blank cards.
shots.narration: 应急准备，有四件必备的资源。

shots.section_title: 资源一：安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研翻开一本空白说明书，上面有危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank safety data sheet booklet showing GHS hazard pictograms in red diamonds.
shots.narration: 第一件：化学品安全技术说明书。
overlay: 资源一：安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 资源一：安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 说明书页面上，急救和泄漏处理两个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank document page with a first aid cross icon and a spill cleanup icon highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 急救、泄漏、灭火方法，里面都有。

shots.section_title: 资源一：安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研把说明书放进实验室门口的文件架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a blank binder on a shelf beside the lab door.
shots.narration: 放在顺手的地方，用之前先查。

shots.section_title: 资源二：管理制度和操作规程
shots.scene: 书架上一排空白文件夹，分别有烧瓶和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with a row of blank binders marked with simple flask and shield icons. No people.
shots.narration: 第二件：实验室管理制度和操作规程。
overlay: 资源二：管理制度和操作规程

shots.section_title: 资源二：管理制度和操作规程
shots.scene: 王老师指着文件夹给阿杰讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank binder and explains it to the young male student.
shots.narration: 还有职业暴露的处置方案，都要读懂。

shots.scene: 老周把一份空白应急预案交给小研
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank emergency plan binder to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 第三件，也是最重要的：应急预案。

shots.scene: 预案页面上，实验室平面图和步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan page with a simple lab floor map and three step icons connected by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 它写明本岗位、本场所出事怎么办。

shots.scene: 台面小火、液体溢洒、手指割伤三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a small flame on a bench, a spilled liquid puddle, and a finger with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 台面着火、溢洒、割伤，都有处置步骤。

shots.section_title: 资源四：跟老师演练应急设施
shots.scene: 王老师带着阿杰和小研在走廊上巡看应急设施
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads the young male student and the female graduate student along a lab corridor, pointing at emergency equipment.
shots.narration: 第四件：请老师或安全员带你演练。
overlay: 资源四：跟老师演练应急设施

shots.section_title: 资源四：跟老师演练应急设施
shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前按下推板，水流向上喷出
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the paddle of an eyewash station and two gentle water streams rise, an eyewash station sign above it.
shots.narration: 洗眼器在哪、怎么开，要亲手试过。

shots.section_title: 资源四：跟老师演练应急设施
shots.scene: 安全淋浴拉杆和安全淋浴标志
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower with a pull handle under a safety shower sign in a lab corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 安全淋浴拉一下就出水，记住位置。

shots.section_title: 资源四：跟老师演练应急设施
shots.scene: 小研从墙上取下灭火毯包
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls a fire blanket out of a wall-mounted pouch.
shots.narration: 灭火毯一拉就出，能盖住小火。

shots.section_title: 资源四：跟老师演练应急设施
shots.scene: 阿杰在王老师指导下手持灭火器练习
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a fire extinguisher during a training drill while the safety administrator watches beside him.
shots.narration: 灭火器怎么用，在演练里学会。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a large telephone icon.
shots.narration: 发现险情，先保护自己，再报警报告。

shots.scene: 两个电话图标，分别是火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: Two telephone icons side by side, one with a flame icon and one with a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 火警打119，急救打120。

shots.scene: 报告链图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 同时报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 阿杰在电话里说话，旁边浮现地点和情况图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student speaks on a phone calmly, with a location pin icon and a flame icon floating beside him.
shots.narration: 讲清地点、发生了什么、有无人受伤。

shots.scene: 墙上的疏散平面图，绿色箭头指向出口
shots.prompt_en: A blank evacuation floor map on a wall with green arrows leading to an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 提前认好疏散路线和安全出口。

shots.scene: 小研关闭实验设备电源后走向出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off a bench instrument and walks calmly toward an exit.
shots.narration: 条件允许，先关电源、关气源再撤离。

shots.scene: 电梯图标打叉，楼梯图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An elevator icon crossed out with a red X next to a stairway icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 走楼梯，不乘电梯，不返回取物品。

shots.scene: 大家在紧急集合点集合，保卫处值班员清点人数
shots.prompt_en: Students gather at an assembly point sign outdoors while the security officer counts them with a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 到集合点清点人数，听从统一指挥。

shots.scene: 老李打开洗眼器放水检查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens an eyewash station to let water flow for a routine check, holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 洗眼器要定期放水，保证出水干净。

shots.scene: 灭火器压力表指针在绿区
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a fire extinguisher pressure gauge with the needle in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器看压力、查有效期。

shots.scene: 洗眼器前堆着纸箱，纸箱被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Cardboard boxes stacked in front of an eyewash station, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 设施前和通道里，不许堆放杂物。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁通道里，四周设施齐全
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a clear lab corridor with an eyewash station, a safety shower and a fire extinguisher around.
shots.narration: 谁也不想遇到紧急情况。

shots.scene: 阿杰自信地指出洗眼器和灭火器的位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student confidently points to the eyewash station and the fire extinguisher while the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 可一旦遇到，准备好的人才不慌。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现报警器和通风图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a ceiling detector and ventilation arrows.
shots.narration: 预警要灵，通风要足。

shots.scene: 说明书、制度、预案、演练四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each with a green check: a data sheet, a binder, an emergency plan and a training drill. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书、制度、预案、演练，一件不少。

shots.scene: 电话、出口、集合点三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a telephone, an emergency exit sign and an assembly point sign. No people.
shots.narration: 会报警、会撤离、会报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera at a lab doorway with a clear corridor behind.
shots.narration: 有备无患，安全实验，下次见！
